title: Evaluation-exact jointly continuous cochain coordinate data
statement:
Let $E$ be a topological field [def-weil-field], $J$ a topological group, $V$ a topological $E$-vector space, and $\rho:J\to\operatorname{Aut}_E(V)$ an $E$-linear action. Let $B,C$ be integer-indexed cochain complexes of abstract $E$-vector spaces, and fix the localization $Q$ to their abstract derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. A jointly continuous cochain coordinate datum for $(E,J,V,\rho,B,C)$ consists of the following data and identities.
For every $n\geq0$ there are injective $E$-linear evaluation maps $b_n:B^n\to\operatorname{Fun}(J^{n+1},V)$ and $c_n:C^n\to\operatorname{Fun}(J^n,V)$. The image of $b_n$ is exactly the jointly continuous functions $F$ satisfying $F(ax_0,\ldots,ax_n)=\rho(a)F(x_0,\ldots,x_n)$, and the image of $c_n$ is exactly all jointly continuous functions. Both complexes are zero in negative degrees. Evaluation identifies the differential on $B$ with
$$(\delta F)(x_0,\ldots,x_{n+1})=\sum_{i=0}^{n+1}(-1)^iF(x_0,\ldots,\widehat{x_i},\ldots,x_{n+1}),$$
and that on $C$ with
$$(df)(g_1,\ldots,g_{n+1})=\rho(g_1)f(g_2,\ldots,g_{n+1})+\sum_{i=1}^{n}(-1)^if(g_1,\ldots,g_i g_{i+1},\ldots,g_{n+1})+(-1)^{n+1}f(g_1,\ldots,g_n),$$
including $(dv)(g)=\rho(g)v-v$. The datum further includes an actual cochain isomorphism $\Phi:B\simeq C$, with inverse $\Psi$, such that
$$c_n(\Phi_n z)(g_1,\ldots,g_n)=b_n(z)(1,g_1,g_1g_2,\ldots,g_1\cdots g_n),$$
$$b_n(\Psi_n z)(x_0,\ldots,x_n)=\rho(x_0)c_n(z)(x_0^{-1}x_1,\ldots,x_{n-1}^{-1}x_n).$$
In degree zero these evaluate at $1$ and send $v$ to $x_0\mapsto\rho(x_0)v$. Finally it includes an isomorphism $D:Q(B)\simeq Q(C)$ whose forward and inverse arrows are respectively $Q(\Phi)$ and $Q(\Psi)$. This defines the coordinate datum; it asserts no existence theorem and imposes no compactness or discreteness conditions.
